1746@SuppressWarnings("ArrayRecordComponent") // TODO we did this originall because it was hot
1747                                                                                        // path but not anymore
1748record CompositeMutableLogProperties(LogProperties[] properties) implements ListLogProperties, MutableLogProperties {
1749
1750        @Override
1751        @SuppressWarnings("ReferenceEquality") // identity check to avoid self-recursion if a
1752                                                                                        // composite contains itself
1753        public MutableLogProperties put(String key, @Nullable String value) {
1754                for (var p : properties()) {
1755                        if (p instanceof MutableLogProperties mp && mp != this) {
1756                                mp.put(key, value);
1757                                return this;
1758                        }
1759                }
1760                return this;
1761        }
1762
1763        @Override
1764        public String toString() {
1765                return toString(new StringBuilder()).toString();
1766        }

1779final class PropertiesParser {
1780
1781        private PropertiesParser() {
1782        }
1783
1784        static Map<String, String> readProperties(String input) {
1785                Map<String, String> m = new LinkedHashMap<>();
1786                StringReader sr = new StringReader(input);
1787                try {
1788                        readProperties(sr, m::put);
1789                }
1790                catch (IOException e) {
1791                        throw new UncheckedIOException(e);
1792                }
1793                return m;
1794        }
1795
1796        static void readProperties(Reader reader, BiConsumer<String, String> consumer) throws IOException {
1797                Properties bp = prepareProperties(consumer);
1798                bp.load(reader);
1799        }
1800
1801        private static Properties prepareProperties(BiConsumer<String, String> consumer) {
1802                // Hack to use properties class to load but our map for preserved order
1803                @SuppressWarnings({ "serial", "nullness" })
1804                Properties bp = new Properties() {
1805                        @Override
1806                        @SuppressWarnings({ "nullness", "keyfor", "UnsynchronizedOverridesSynchronized" }) // checker
1807                                                                                                                                                                                                // bug
1808                        public @Nullable Object put(Object key, Object value) {
1809                                Objects.requireNonNull(key);
1810                                Objects.requireNonNull(value);
1811                                consumer.accept((String) key, (String) value);
1812                                return null;
1813                        }
1814                };
1815                return bp;
1816        }
1817
1818}
1819
1820/*
1821 * The key.keys form of LogProperties.mapOrNull, shared with implementations that override
1822 * it.
1823 */
1824final class PropertyMaps {
1825
1826        private PropertyMaps() {
1827        }
1828
1829        static @Nullable Map<String, String> fromKeys(LogProperties properties, String key) {
1830                String keysKey = key + LogProperties.SEP + LogProperties.MAP_KEYS_SUFFIX;
1831                List<String> keys = properties.listOrNull(keysKey);
1832                if (keys == null) {
1833                        return null;
1834                }
1835                Map<String, String> m = new LinkedHashMap<>();
1836                for (String k : keys) {
1837                        if (k.isEmpty()) {
1838                                throw new IllegalArgumentException("'" + keysKey + "' has an empty map key");
1839                        }
1840                        String valueKey = key + LogProperties.SEP + k;
1841                        String v = properties.valueOrNull(valueKey);
1842                        if (v == null) {
1843                                throw new IllegalArgumentException(
1844                                                "map key '" + k + "' is listed in '" + keysKey + "' but '" + valueKey + "' is missing");
1845                        }
1846                        m.put(k, v);
1847                }
1848                return m;
1849        }
1850
1851}
